verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's enterprise product has a web UI for findings and routing (trufflehog-docs-10, trufflehog-docs-11) plus a CLI, but there is no evidence of a public API — the openapi/swagger probe found all candidate endpoints 404 (trufflehog-probe-3) and no docs mention API-based access to findings, alerts, or RBAC settings shown in the UI (trufflehog-docs-24). Missing for 10: any documented REST/GraphQL API, API parity claims, or evidence that UI-only features (SSO, RBAC, alert routing) are accessible programmatically.
